Use nested if-then-else expressions to determine quadrant based on coordinates in PascalABC.NET
output:
begin
  var (x,y) := (5,-3);
  var q := 
    if x>0 then
      if y>0 then
        1
      else 4
    else
      if y>0 then
        2
      else 3;
        
  Print(q)
end.

Use nested if statements for grade evaluation in PascalABC.NET
output:
// Nested conditional operators
var x: integer;

begin
  writeln('Enter grade (1..5): ');
  readln(x);
  if (x=1) then 
    writeln('One')
  else if (x=2) then 
    writeln('Two')
  else if (x=3) then 
    writeln('Three')
  else if (x=4) then 
    writeln('Four')
  else if (x=5) then 
    writeln('Five')  
  else writeln('No such grade')  
end.
